name: Squirrel Internet
summary: Brisbane ISP (Squirrel Internet / Squirrel Net), offices Level 30, Riverside Centre, 123 Eagle St, Brisbane CBD — known for a live webcam of the Brisbane CBD (Story Bridge) in 1998 and a 1,200-shop shopping portal. One /22-scale 1997 allocation (SQUIRREL1-AU 203.31.36-39, Wacol QLD). Acquired by Chariot Ltd with Blue Pin Internet, announced 8 Aug 2003.

events.details: Registered in the 1997 IP Network Index as Squirrel Internet, Wacol QLD (SQUIRREL1-AU 203.31.36.0-203.31.39.255, contiguous /22). squirrel.net.au captured from 2 Dec 1998 — 'Squirrel Internet ... Level 30, Riverside Centre, 123 Eagle St. Brisbane Qld 4000', running a live webcam of the Brisbane CBD with an online shopping portal.

events.details: Acquired by Chariot Ltd: 'has acquired the NSW-based Blue Pin and Brisbane-based Squirrel Net' (SMH, 8 Aug 2003), part of Chariot's strategy to secure a top-six ISP position. squirrel.net.au is listed as a Chariot netconnect customer mail domain by the 25 Mar 2005 portal capture.
